title: Interface static methods versus default methods
answer: A default interface method is inherited by implementing classes and is invoked through an instance, so an implementation may override it. A static interface method belongs to the interface itself, is called with the interface name, and is not inherited as an instance method. Both provide behavior but serve different dispatch and API-design purposes.
